newsitem.title: USA: Continental Cablevision offers Internet access.
newsitem.headline: Continental Cablevision offers Internet access.

text.p: Continental Cablevision Inc said Monday it had begun offering high-speed Internet access through "cable modems" and cable TV lines to residents in the Boston area.

The company said it was using fiber optic-coaxial cable network to offer the service called "Highway1," which reduces the time it takes to "download" data, makes it easier to use Internet, World Wide Web and other applications.
It said it would offer the service to Needham, Wellesley and eventually Newton.

The company described Highway1 as a precursor to a wide-scale product offering in service areas around the country, with high-speed Internet access being phased in nationally during the next 12 months.
Continental's network in the New England region will be capable of delivering the service to about 225,000 homes by year's end, it said.
